deploy-bot: Deploy completed: prompt-router-experimental v2 -> traffic 25% to canary at 2024-04-01T18:20:34Z :rocket:
ops-monitor: alert: increased 5xx rate on /prompt-route/v2 from 0.4% -> 12% (p50 latency steady). Detecting spike across eu-west-1 and us-west-2.
raj: paging oncall (sara) — spike looks correlated with canary. Paging now.
sara (oncall): on it, pulling logs and traces. assigning priority P1.
sara (oncall): quick check: error pattern is backend 504 from gpu-proxy, stacktrace shows kvcache keymiss flood on first tokens. sample logs:```
2024-04-01T18:21:12Z ERROR proxy: index error: missing_kv shard=23 req=...
2024-04-01T18:21:13Z WARN router: retrying request id=...
```
dave (eng-lead): can we immediately gate the experimental route? if it's causing customer impact we should cut traffic.
mike: I can trigger the emergency featuregate. preparing command.
mike: running: `./featuregatectl set prompt-router.experimental false --scope=global --reason="urgent-5xx-canary"`
incident-bot: featuregate update scheduled by mike at 2024-04-01T18:22:07Z: prompt-router.experimental -> false (emergency) :warning:
ops-monitor: traffic shifted: canary traffic dropped from 25% -> 0% in 10s. 5xx rate falling back to baseline.
lucy: confirming customer-facing routes are now on stable. latency is back to normal, continued monitoring.
sara (oncall): handing off to dave for post-rollout investigation. summary for handoff: "canary caused kvcache missstorm at startup path; emergency gate applied; no rollback of stable; CS notified; status page updated."
dave (eng-lead): thanks. initiating deeper debug. will check kernel mismatches and quantization config between stable and v2. tagging mike and raj to follow.
amanda (support): flagging top 3 customers who saw errors in last 10m, preparing outreach templates.
mike: backup plan executed: can do a controlled rollback to v1 for canary path if needed, but gate did the trick for now. keeping canary disabled until root cause fixed.
raj: creating incident ticket: INC-2024-0421, notes added, severity P1 mitigated -> monitoring. scheduled postmortem for tomorrow 11:00 PT.
incident-bot: pagerlog: page acknowledged by sara at 2024-04-01T18:21:47Z, gate applied at 2024-04-01T18:22:07Z, mitigation validated at 2024-04-01T18:24:00Z.
dave (eng-lead): quick checklist to capture in postmortem: what changed in v2 (kv layout, patched attention kernel), startup traffic behavior, logfile correlation IDs, potential race in cache priming.
sara (oncall): leaving a short runbook update: if experimental prompt-router spike >5% error: 1) featuregate off, 2) notify CS, 3) collect sample requests, 4) escalate to runtime team.
lucy: re: customer impact — no major accounts lost requests, CS will follow up with targeted outreach to affected customers, incident severity may drop to P2 once we confirm no residual errors in next hour.
amanda (support): sending first outreach message to affected customers now. template: "We observed elevated errors on the new routing option; traffic was automatically shifted back to stable at 18:22 UTC; root cause investigation ongoing; we'll follow up with remediation plan."
raj: recording all artifacts (logs, kernel versions, featuregate history) to INC-2024-0421.
dave (eng-lead): if anyone grabs the postmortem, ping me. I'll attach perf traces and kernel diffs.
sara (oncall): handing off monitoring to lucy for the night. I'm going offline in 10. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated. next steps: postmortem assignment, customer followups, fix branch for kvcache priming.
